assertions.name: coordination_multiplier_is_equal_weight_limit_exact_alpha_coincidence_nucleon
assertions.source: nucleon bond energies have a derived 1.78× spread ⇒ equal-weight (coordination counting) fails there; it is exact only for identical α–α bonds. The mirror split ε_nn−ε_pp=0.542 that equal-weight drops is the isospin carrier Vol, giving w_n=M·Vol.

description: The coordination-number binding multiplier is the EQUAL-WEIGHT limit of the derived log-trace bond-extensivity B=E₀·Σ log(1/f_bond) (#2089). Equal-weight is exact for identical α–α bonds (α-cluster contact counting derived) but fails at the nucleon level (derived ε_pp:ε_pn:ε_nn spread 1.78×); the nucleon z=A−1 is a composition coincidence. The split ε_nn−ε_pp equal-weight drops is the isospin carrier Vol, so w_n=M·Vol = (equal-weight coordination)·(isospin bond asymmetry). Answers 'why multiplier=coordination'; not a closure. Scope-(a).
